snippet.description:
I really enjoy the world in Humanitz. Some parts of it are so believable, and it's so fun to go around and explore all the different POIs. There is a lot of attention to detail here and I respect it. Driving the vehicles around also feels great, so shout out to exploring in Humanitz!
